name: Armond Temperance
source: Born September 1, 210 FE, in Boston, Massachusetts. A storied war hero and the former pilot of the Melchior Y. Something of a celebrity, despite his reserved, cautious, and modest personality. No longer piloting mechs, he now leads a team of pilots on the OFS ship the Nauvoo.
